findings.summary: Vitest discovery constrained via include: ["tests/**/*.test.ts"] in vitest.config.ts:5; full run collects exactly the 25 root suites and excludes nested .ways/worktrees suites.

Digest prefix instability fixed via DIGEST_DIFF pinning --src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/ in both committedWorkDigest and workDigest (src/work/digest.ts:33-36,42,49); review digest stable under diff.mnemonicPrefix=true and diff.noprefix=true and workDigest equals committedWorkDigest.
